verdict.rationale: The Track API and Pipelines API/SDKs send real-time event tracking tied to identified customers. The journeys docs state that automations can trigger "when profiles perform events," and an automation's first component is its Trigger, so a custom event from the product starts a workflow for the profile that did it. missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring an event-triggered automation (event name or attribute filters, per-person entry rules), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the end-to-end event-to-automation flow.
